ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with isolated, high-contrast (white/grey) circular outlines and a small basal patch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast circular rings (rosettes) are distributed throughout. A localized light-intensity patch is visible at the inferior-center (peduncle junction).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with symmetric convergence of the inner lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing boundary, with maximum pixel-amplitude spikes located near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning into upward-tapering, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (scars) distributed across the mid-region of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular high-intensity bulbous mass (biofouling/barnacle cluster) localized on the distal-most tip of the left lobe; similar but smaller protrusion on the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density of well-defined circular ring scars creating a 'bubble' effect across the dark pigmentation.
